stdout.text:
Create a release evidence bundle from local artifacts

Usage: mantle release create [OPTIONS] --release-id <RELEASE_ID> --binary <BINARY> --proof-bundle <PROOF_BUNDLE>

Options:
      --release-id <RELEASE_ID>
          Release identifier recorded in the bundle manifest
  -v, --verbose
          Enable verbose logging
      --bundle-dir <BUNDLE_DIR>
          Output directory for the bundle (default: target/release-evidence/<release-id>)
      --log-level <LOG_LEVEL>
          Log level (trace, debug, info, warn, error)
      --binary <BINARY>
          Release binary artifact to bundle (repeat for multiple binaries)
      --json
          Emit errors as JSON objects for tooling integration
      --proof-bundle <PROOF_BUNDLE>
          Full self-hosting proof bundle directory from ./scripts/prove-self-hosting.sh
      --store <STORE>
          Where to export final build outputs on disk. Intermediate deps stay in castore. Source inputs always come from /nix/store. If not writable, builds still succeed (outputs in castore) [default: /nix/store]
      --provider-fixed-point-proof <PROVIDER_FIXED_POINT_PROOF>
          Provider-backed Cargo-free fixed-point proof bundle to package as bounded release-adjacent evidence
      --store-prefix <STORE_PREFIX>
          Logical store path prefix for derivation hashes. All output paths and ATerm hashes are computed against this prefix. Default: /mantle/store. Use --nix-compat for /nix/store [default: /mantle/store]
      --nix-compat
          Shorthand for --store-prefix=/nix/store. For interop testing with Nix-computed derivations
      --reproducibility-report <REPRODUCIBILITY_REPORT>
          Optional canonical reproducibility report to package in the bundle
      --source-acquisition-url <SOURCE_ACQUISITION_URL>
          External source archive URL witnesses can fetch before rebuilding
      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>
          State directory for pathinfo.redb, blobs, and logs. Default: legacy $CRUNCH_STATE_DIR or $XDG_STATE_HOME/crunch or ~/.local/state/crunch. Use --state-dir for an explicit Mantle path
      --remote-binding-config <REMOTE_BINDING_CONFIG>
          Operator-owned endpoint binding configuration for production remote operations
      --source-observation <SOURCE_OBSERVATION>
          Optional path to a versioned source-observation binding (JSON) recorded with the release source
      --git-source-url <GIT_SOURCE_URL>
          Git remote URL witnesses can fetch to derive the release source archive
      --store-backend <STORE_BACKEND>
          Durable store backend (snix or casita) [default: snix]
      --base-store <BASE_STORES>
          Ordered list of read-only base store state directories for overlay composition. Declared in priority order (base A before base B)
      --git-source-commit <GIT_SOURCE_COMMIT>
          Pinned Git commit for --git-source-url
      --git-source-ref <GIT_SOURCE_REF>
          Optional Git ref that must resolve to --git-source-commit during witness replay
      --git-source-tag <GIT_SOURCE_TAG>
          Optional Git tag that must resolve to --git-source-commit during witness replay
      --workflow-command <WORKFLOW_COMMAND>
          Workflow command identity recorded in the manifest [default: ./scripts/prove-self-hosting.sh]
      --cairn-handoff <CAIRN_HANDOFF>
          Cairn handoff descriptor whose referenced artifact and policy bytes are measured, bundled, and bound to this exact release
      --external-evidence <EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE>
          External evidence sidecar file to bundle opaquely (repeat with matching role/schema/scope)
      --external-evidence-role <EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE_ROLE>
          Role for each --external-evidence entry, e.g. stack-provenance-trace
      --external-evidence-schema <EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA>
          Schema identifier for each --external-evidence entry
      --external-evidence-claim-scope <EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE_CLAIM_SCOPE>
          Claim scope for each --external-evidence entry
      --external-evidence-non-claim <EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE_NON_CLAIM>
          Non-claim text applied to bundled external evidence entries
      --kani-toolchain-evidence <KANI_TOOLCHAIN_EVIDENCE>
          Kani toolchain identity metadata JSON linked to a bundled Kani receipt
      --stack-provenance-sidecar <STACK_PROVENANCE_SIDECAR>
          Valence stack-provenance sidecar to package as bounded external evidence
      --stack-provenance-valence-receipt <STACK_PROVENANCE_VALENCE_RECEIPT>
          Valence stack-provenance graph report/receipt for the sidecar
      --stack-provenance-binary <STACK_PROVENANCE_BINARY>
          Release binary input this stack-provenance sidecar names; required when multiple binaries are bundled
      --requirement-evidence-root <REQUIREMENT_EVIDENCE_ROOT>
          Capability root for content-bound requirement input and evidence files
      --requirement-evidence-input <REQUIREMENT_EVIDENCE_INPUT>
          Capability-relative content-bound requirement creation input
      --workflow-version <WORKFLOW_VERSION>
          Workflow version recorded in the manifest [default: mantle-self-hosting-proof-v2]
  -h, --help
          Print help

Verify a release evidence bundle using bundle-local contents only

Usage: mantle release verify [OPTIONS] <BUNDLE_DIR>

Arguments:
  <BUNDLE_DIR>  Bundle directory to verify

Options:
      --require-reproducible
          Fail unless a verified reproducibility report is present and matched
  -v, --verbose
          Enable verbose logging
      --log-level <LOG_LEVEL>
          Log level (trace, debug, info, warn, error)
      --require-stagex-no-quorum
          Require StageX-class lineage proof with no-quorum profile
      --deterministic-proof <DETERMINISTIC_PROOF>
          Canonical deterministic build proof artifact from `release reproduce`
      --json
          Emit errors as JSON objects for tooling integration
      --deterministic-sandbox-isolation-evidence <DETERMINISTIC_SANDBOX_ISOLATION_EVIDENCE>
          Canonical deterministic sandbox isolation evidence artifact from `release reproduce`
      --store <STORE>
          Where to export final build outputs on disk. Intermediate deps stay in castore. Source inputs always come from /nix/store. If not writable, builds still succeed (outputs in castore) [default: /nix/store]
      --require-deterministic-release
          Fail unless deterministic proof artifacts prove release-artifact determinism
      --store-prefix <STORE_PREFIX>
          Logical store path prefix for derivation hashes. All output paths and ATerm hashes are computed against this prefix. Default: /mantle/store. Use --nix-compat for /nix/store [default: /mantle/store]
      --nix-compat
          Shorthand for --store-prefix=/nix/store. For interop testing with Nix-computed derivations
      --provider-fixed-point-proof <PROVIDER_FIXED_POINT_PROOF>
          Cargo-free provider fixed-point proof bundle to validate as bounded release-adjacent evidence
      --require-external-evidence-role <REQUIRE_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE_ROLE>
          Fail unless a bundled external evidence entry with this role is present (repeatable)
      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>
          State directory for pathinfo.redb, blobs, and logs. Default: legacy $CRUNCH_STATE_DIR or $XDG_STATE_HOME/crunch or ~/.local/state/crunch. Use --state-dir for an explicit Mantle path
      --remote-binding-config <REMOTE_BINDING_CONFIG>
          Operator-owned endpoint binding configuration for production remote operations
      --require-provider-fixed-point-proof
          Fail unless a valid provider fixed-point proof bundle is supplied
      --release-profile <RELEASE_PROFILE>
          Release verification profile; onix-stack requires Valence stack-provenance evidence [default: generic]
      --store-backend <STORE_BACKEND>
          Durable store backend (snix or casita) [default: snix]
      --base-store <BASE_STORES>
          Ordered list of read-only base store state directories for overlay composition. Declared in priority order (base A before base B)
      --stack-provenance <STACK_PROVENANCE>
          Stack-provenance policy for generic releases; release-profile can require a stricter mode [default: optional] [possible values: optional, required]
      --requirement-coverage <REQUIREMENT_COVERAGE>
          Content-bound requirement coverage policy for this verification [default: optional] [possible values: optional, required]
      --source-review-policy <SOURCE_REVIEW_POLICY>
          Trusted source-review verification policy; supplying it requires accepted source review
      --require-source-review
          Require accepted source review under an explicitly supplied trusted policy
  -h, --help
          Print help
PUBLIC TEST ONLY actual tiny output; no build correctness claim
